title: isodon henryi
intro: Isodon henryi, commonly known as Henry's isodon or Henry's golden root, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is native to China and has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing inflammation, fighting against free radicals, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of Isodon henryi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
